correctness.rationale: The frozen RESULT.md defines the open two-leg uniform-adjacency graph P2 square Pn for every n>=2, H_gamma=A-i gamma |a,1><a,1| with gamma>0, and input |b,n>. Product path/rung eigenvalues are 2cos(pi k/(n+1)) +/-1; each simple level is visible at the sink. The cyclotomic trace lemma correctly restricts the cross-band difference 2 to path eigenvalues +/-1 (indices (n+1)/3 and 2(n+1)/3), only if 3 divides n+1, giving exactly one zero-energy dark direction. The sink-cancellation vector (phi_{+,2t}-phi_{-,t})/sqrt2 with t=(n+1)/3 has source amplitude -c(1+(-1)^t)/sqrt2, c=sqrt3/(2sqrt(n+1)), giving 3/[2(n+1)] for n=5 mod 6 and zero otherwise. Bright complement has strictly negative imaginary spectrum by the dissipative quadratic form; finite Jordan blocks decay and the long-time norm is the dark projection, independent of gamma. Independently written check performed 59 exact Chebyshev-polynomial gcd tests for n=2..60 and 39 direct symmetric-adjacency projector tests for n=2..40 (98 passing checks). A first test-script comparison raised a spurious SymPy Poly domain-equality assertion despite identical expressions; corrected by comparing expressions, not by changing any result. Finite checks corroborate rather than prove the universal assertion. No contradiction found, including n=2, n=5, n=8, n=11, n=17 boundary examples.
